title: Pay ordered programs, accessible geometry and resolved products
statement: At one thousand programs with 2 nmol initiator each, the same organization consumes 120 micromol packets, 40 micromol program strands and twenty thousand ordered module placements per cycle before other fuels. A hypothetical 30 nm pitch implies about 1084 square meters, useful only if complete machinery and wash flow can access it. Resolving each product for 6–20 minutes requires 100–333 instrument-hours plus controls. Shared codons, porous supports or pooling do not make these operations free.

evidence.range_scope: Whole available P3 final and expanded top-level activity; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Sixteen specified abiotic products, each requiring twenty ordered covalent growth operations, share the reagent environment. The target is at least 1 nmol authenticated correct product per program within 24 hours, at least 90% correct full sequences before selective salvage and at least 50% initiator yield. Ten cycles must retarget four libraries while preserving the stated functional stocks and useful output. Every coupling, physical clearance, hidden error, program/adaptor/enzyme stock, release, assay, preparation, waste and reset operation retains its actual cost and qualification boundary.

assumptions: Simultaneous chemical rates, confinement, stock yields, photochemical behavior, aging, optical response and prices are introduced unless explicitly source-anchored. DNA-bond progression or an incorporated capture handle does not establish completion of the intended peptoid amide. Wrong strong bonds can pass retention; stalled chains remain in crude output. The fragment counterexample concerns pooled composition ladders, not all chromatography or mass spectrometry. A favorable parameter region is not a compatible material system. ROOT calculations require actual sensing and separation; held unread originals are not imported. No working twenty-step factory, qualified renewal, useful function, novelty or whole-service advantage is established.
costs: Complete 44,061-byte P3 capture 4e88c806 and 12,466-byte issued question a1675012; 70m45s visible activity is not compute usage. Native final ID, database text and prefix are unknown; rendering gaps and unread nested tools/web/subagents remain. Linked HTML/code/ZIP were not collected and their identity/transfer eligibility are unverified. The 9,555-byte ROOT note 611f4fc4 and its supplied Python 39e602d9/JSON 7736512d are preserved as evidence, not executed by Capital. The P3 public capture is byte-identical; ROOT public text changes only two asset locators. All source/access/transfer holds persist. No new Capital scientific execution, physical validation or independent audit.
contract.units: Source-reported finite chemical, transport, financial, mechanical and measurement quantities at their stated assumptions; no Capital scientific execution.
obstruction: Construct chemically selective, local and single-use product-to-progression coupling, actual absorbing clearance and compatible reset. Qualify each released population and the mixed library using calibrated structural standards, then establish useful physical response, functional stock renewal and complete matched cost. The proposed $42,925 two-extension experiment is unexecuted and would not establish the full library factory.

review.scope: Whole supplied original available derivations at exact stated scope; reported numerical execution is not physical qualification, a supplier quotation, novelty, an integrated invention or a new independent Capital audit.
